How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
Orders currently take an average of 1–2 business days to process before shipping. After that, estimated transit times within the contiguous U.S. are 1–3 days to the West Coast, 3–4 days to the Central U.S., 4–5 days to the Midwest, and 5–7 days to the East Coast.
These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates. You’ll receive a tracking email when your order is ready to ship. See our delivery information for the latest details.

What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Our manufacturer’s warranty covers broken or defective parts on orders placed directly with us. We provide replacement parts free of charge for up to 90 days after purchase; you don’t need to return the item to get replacement parts. Damage from misuse or negligence isn’t covered, and items bought from third-party sellers are covered by those sellers’ policies.
You can read the details and submit a claim on our warranty page.
